name: Kraft Heinz
description: Kraft Heinz makes and sells packaged food and drinks under Kraft, Heinz, Oscar Mayer, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Ore-Ida, Maxwell House, Kool-Aid and Jell-O, sold mostly through grocery and large-format retailers; 75 percent of net sales are in North America, where the five largest customers are about 46 percent of segment sales. Money comes from branded condiments, sauces, ready meals, cheese, meat and drinks sold at wide margins that have been squeezed by volume declines and input costs. The 2015 merger left it with about $59.7B of goodwill and brand intangibles, which it has been writing down: $9.3B in 2025 and a further $7.35B in the second quarter of 2026. It announced a plan on 2025-09-02 to split into two companies, then paused that work on 2026-02-11.
